title: Operational Plan for Continuing Operations Against Cuba
title_ja: キューバに対する継続作戦の作戦計画
summary: Operational plan for continuing operations against Cuba, including intelligence gathering, potential actions to weaken the Castro regime, economic warfare, and political and psychological warfare.
summary_ja: キューバに対する作戦継続のための作戦計画、情報収集、カストロ政権を弱体化させるための潜在的な行動、経済戦争、政治的・心理的戦争を含む。
sender: William K. Harvey, Chief, Task Force W
